summary: 3–4 week on-campus winter research internship with IIT Bhubaneswar faculty, running 5 Dec 2026 – 2 Jan 2027.
eligibility: Students in degree programmes at any recognised institution in India (engineering, sciences, humanities); a No Objection Certificate from your institute is required.
title: IIT Bhubaneswar Winter Internship 2026

prize.description: No fixed stipend; some supervisors pay a fellowship from project funds. Hostel on payment, if available.

notes: Online portal only (webapps.iitbbs.ac.in/internship-application); email or offline applications are not accepted.
Deadline is 5 Nov 2026, 11:00 PM IST, per secondary sources; confirm on the IIT Bhubaneswar page.
support: Hostel on payment, subject to availability · no travel support listed
